correctness.rationale: All characteristic-two and ring hypotheses are explicit; U=A+epsilon B reduces bijectively to N^2=0, NB=BN. Explicit centralizer block form has dimension 2r^2+2rs+s^2, with unit count q^d Phi_r Phi_s; orbit-stabilizer gives the full finite distribution including r=0 and s=0. A quantified Euler-product inequality proves total variation O_q(n^-1), not extrapolated from enumeration. Packaged independent brute-force computations over GF2 and GF4 match each finite fiber.

value.rationale: The invariant is the natural reduction rank of the order-two variety in GL_n of a split length-two local ring. Determining all rank fibers and their quantitative uniform limit across arbitrary dimensions and all fields of characteristic two exposes a qualitative contrast with field-only involutions and gives a reusable exact algebraic enumerator, rather than an arbitrary small table.
